1989-2000.what: Ground floor of the front was turned into a shopfront. In 1989 it had a plain wall, a door under a small flat canopy and two small windows with flower-box sills. By 2000 there is a deep fascia board across the front, a big plain panel where the left window was, the door sits in a framed surround, and a dark box (sign or light) hangs on the wall to the right of the door. The upper floor looks the same.
1989-2000.why: Probably a change of use: the house was made into a shop or business. That is a guess from the look.

2000-2010.what: The side facing the lane got an addition. In 2000 it was a plain dark boarded wall with small windows. By 2010 there is a first-floor balcony with a railing and a door onto it, and a glazed ground-floor extension (many narrow panes) under it. The shopfront on the quay-road front is unchanged.
2000-2010.why: An owner's extension or enlargement, perhaps a sun room or cafe space. I cannot tell the purpose.

2000-2010.what: The gable window and the two windows below it were boarded up with braced planks in 2000. By 2010 all three are proper glazed windows with panes and sills again.
2000-2010.why: Looks like the house stood empty or neglected in 2000 and was repaired and lived in again by 2010. A guess.

how_well: Where the change was big and close (B's shopfront, B's balcony and glazed extension, D's boarded windows) the window let me see it at once, because the same spot sits side by side in the two years and the outside gives the later year. For A (2010 to 2020), C (1989 to 2000 and 2010 to 2020) and E (1989 to 2000 and 2000 to 2010) I found no difference I could point to, in any view; the city views are too small to read anything, E is a dark shape in shade far up the lane, and the circle often covers most of the house so there is little of the later year to compare with.
believed: That the circled house had changed: a window over a house made me look for a change, and for A, C and E I found none, so I cannot say whether they changed in ways that do not show here (paint, wear, small details).
That the houses I list nothing for did not change, and that neighbours not circled did not change; the pictures do not show that.
That the change happened in the years of the pair: I only see two moments, so a change could have come at any time in between.
That the reasons I give (B made into a shop, D empty then repaired) are true; the pictures show the new look, not why it was done, and not who did it.
That D was already boarded in 1989: no picture shows D in 1989, so I only know it was boarded in 2000.
